points: Designed and deployed 8+ enterprise AI agents using LangGraph, Microsoft Copilot Studio and Oracle AI Agent Studio, cutting manual effort in finance and procurement workflows by ~60%.
Built multi-agent pipelines with LangChain and CrewAI for invoice processing, vendor onboarding and customer support triage.
Developed N8n workflows linking AI agents to Oracle Fusion ERP, email triggers and approvals across 5+ business processes.
Built an AI evals framework across 200+ test cases, improving agent reliability by 35% through iterative prompt optimisation.
Built 5+ FastAPI microservices exposing agents as REST endpoints, plus RAG apps on Azure AI Foundry and AI Search over 10K+ documents.
Delivered 15+ Oracle Fusion REST/SOAP integrations via OIC and migrated 30+ BI Publisher reports from EBS to Fusion Cloud.
